question: From what locus is the supreme self to be brought into the prepared body?
premises: The body has been mentally constructed and made fit for deity worship.
The heart-lotus serves as the designated source for invocation.
The supreme self is the entity to be brought forth.
inference: Therefore, once the body is prepared, the practitioner should bring the supreme self from the heart-lotus.
plain_english: One should bring the supreme self forth from the lotus of the heart.
